renders.text:
# Available tools

## `legal_draft_v3`

Draft a new contract. Works on the contracts and clauses data set.

**Parameters**

- `counterparty` (*string*, required) — Other party.
- `value` (*number*, required) — Contract value. Value must be at least 0.
- `term_months` (*integer*, required) — Length of the term.
- `auto_renew` (*boolean*, optional) — Whether it renews automatically. Default: `False`.
- `contract_details` (*object*, optional) — Details of the contract.
    - `contract_id` (*string*, optional) — Contract number.
    - `status` (*one of `draft`, `review`, `signed`, `expired`*, optional) — Where it stands.

**Returns** — the contract id
